text:
Arjun: Kicking off handoff for the new eu-west5 GPU cluster. Wanted to run through paging, ownership, and a quick validation checklist before we tag this as oncall-ready.
Faye: Thanks — what state is provisioning in? still doing node image updates?
Arjun: Node image is done. GPU drivers and MIG profiles applied, NCCL tests passed. Final step is setting pager rules and capacity limits.
oncall-bot: Deployment notice: eu-west5-gpu-cluster bootstrap completed at 2026-02-15T09:12:57Z :rocket:
Samir: Perfect. I'm going to paste the proposed pager config we tested in staging. Please review and call out if anything missing.
Samir: ```
route: /services/eu-west5/gpu-health
level_map:
  CRITICAL: p1
  ERROR: p2
  WARNING: p3
responders:
  - type: team
    id: oncall/sre
  - type: escalation
    id: eng-infra
escalation_policy:
  - wait: 5m
    notify: primary
  - wait: 15m
    notify: team_lead
  - wait: 30m
    notify: ops_manager
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/eu-west5-bootstrap
  owner: infra/sre
```
Priya: Suggest adding a receiver for capacity alerts that goes to infra-cost so they get notified of unexpected GPU spin-ups.
Luca: Agreed — we had one incident where autoscale misconfiguration caused 40 GPUs to spin for 2 hours and cost 8x normal. Add a budget threshold.
Samir: Will add cost threshold: `budget_threshold: 0.25` (alerts at 25% over expected). Also adding a suppression window for scheduled load tests.
Arjun: Who owns oncall rotation for eu-west5? We should map primary/secondary and put escalation contact info in the runbook.
Faye: Primary: Samir (weekdays), Secondary: Priya, Escalation: Arjun. I'll update the rotation doc and add their PD ids.
Priya: Quick checklist for oncall to validate after claim:
- confirm `kubectl get nodes` shows all GPU nodes Ready
- run `nvidia-smi` on a node, ensure driver and MIG look healthy
- run sample inference job (mini-benchmark) against model-serving-svc and check latency under 200ms for p99
- check scheduler queues for stuck pods (`kubectl get pods -n model-serving -o wide | grep ImagePullBackOff`)
- confirm cost dashboard updated and budget threshold set

Samir: Also add a network connectivity test: `curl -I https://metadata.google.internal` and `nc -vz 10.0.12.3 9100` to make sure node-exporter and metadata endpoints accessible.
Arjun: Training notes: we'll do a 30-minute runthrough tomorrow 10:00 UTC with the oncall rotation, live demo of failing GPUs and triggering pager, and verify escalations.
Luca: Can we add a line to the runbook about fallback models? If eu-west5 capacity is exhausted, traffic should route to eu-west1 cheaper model tier, but with reduced quality. That needs an automated fallback rule.
Samir: Good call. Adding `fallback_route: eu-west1:low-cost-models` and a note about expected quality delta.
oncall-bot: Reminder: runbook review session scheduled 2026-02-16T10:00:00Z — invite sent to @oncall-team :bell:
Faye: Final ask — please validate pager noise thresholds. We had too many warning-level pages last quarter. Set `warning` to aggregate 3 events in 5m before paging.
Samir: Done. I'll push the config to pagerduty and post the validation logs here once applied.
Arjun: Thanks everyone. After the 10:00 runthrough, if we see no blockers, I'll mark eu-west5 as SRE-owned and handoff complete.
Priya: I'll prepare a short two-slide cheat sheet for oncall (commands + quick triage steps) and drop to the runbook link.
Luca: Added a note to include cost playbook contact (billing-ops).
Samir: Config applied to staging and prod. Test alert sent — got ack from Samir and Priya. All green. :white_check_mark:
Arjun: Excellent. Closing thread once training done. Anyone object to making this the official handoff?
Faye: No objections.
Priya: LGTM.
Luca: LGTM.
Samir: LGTM.
oncall-bot: Thread closed by Arjun at 2026-02-15T09:13:30Z
